practice_units.title: Tribal Societies
practice_units.problem: Explain how tribal societies were different from the societies that followed the caste system.
guidance: Tribal societies were usually not divided into many castes.
They often shared resources like land and pastures collectively.
They had their own unique cultures and oral traditions.
practice_units.solution: Unlike caste-based societies, tribal groups were more egalitarian, shared resources collectively, and lived in close contact with nature.
